votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 14 of 2024 authorizing a fully discounted land conveyance of Tier 2 property at approximately 524 North 300 West to Salt Lake City Corporation
votes.description: The resolution authorizes the RDA to transfer ownership of the Marmalade Plaza property (0.56 acres at 524 North 300 West) to Salt Lake City Corporation at no cost for continued management as a public open space.
